query:
-- Check dangling records in each table
SELECT 'claim_approvals' as tbl, COUNT(*) as dangling 
FROM claim_approvals ca LEFT JOIN claims c ON ca.claim_id = c.id WHERE c.id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'final_approval_records', COUNT(*) 
FROM final_approval_records far LEFT JOIN claims c ON far.claim_id = c.id WHERE c.id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'approval_workflow', COUNT(*) 
FROM approval_workflow aw LEFT JOIN claims c ON aw.claim_id = c.id WHERE c.id IS NULL;
